Help with pet comfort in detail
An orderly week is easier when you know what to expect

Companion Animal Travel Desk

The Companion Animal Travel Desk at Aurelia Skyways supports travelers who arrange journeys with pets and other companion animals. Our records aide keeps each request clear, so families can move through the process with less uncertainty and more calm.

When you prepare a trip, share the basic details of the animal, the route, and any comfort needs as early as possible. This helps the desk review the file and note the items that may matter at the airport and during the flight. A senior coordinator oversees daily service decisions, and staff members follow that guidance carefully.

Travelers are encouraged to keep carriers clean, secure, and familiar to the animal before departure. A small blanket, a favorite toy, or a well-used liner can support a steadier journey. It also helps to check that food, water, and documents are in order before you arrive for service.

If a pet has special handling needs, the desk can record them with care and pass them along to the proper teams. This may include quieter waiting arrangements, extra review of carrier fit, or attention to a traveler's boarding path. The goal is to reduce stress while keeping the record complete and accurate.

Please keep all communication direct and brief, and bring any needed papers in a form that can be reviewed without delay. If plans change, let the desk know at once so the file can be updated and the animal's travel notes remain current.

For further assistance, please contact the Companion Animal Travel Desk at Aurelia Skyways.
